# Sugarcoat Salon | Hair, Makeup, Nail & Skin Services in Hennur, Bangalore

> Sugarcoat Salon is a premium unisex hair and beauty salon on Hennur Main Road, Bangalore (Kannuru, 560077). Services: haircuts and styling, hair spa, keratin, hair smoothening, hair botox/plastia, hair colouring, facials, hydra and Korean glass skin facials, waxing, nail extensions, gel polish, manicure/pedicure, and bridal and party makeup. Rated 4.9/5 on Google (72 reviews). Open every day, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

## Business Details

- Name: Sugarcoat Salon (also listed as Sugarcoat Salon and Makeup Studio)
- Address: 1st Floor, Capital Market, Hennur Main Road, near Kanakashree Housing Society, Kannuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560077
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 82965 45458
- Email: sugarcoatsalon.in@gmail.com
- Hours: 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM, all 7 days
- Type: Unisex salon (men, women and kids)
- Areas served: Hennur, Kannuru, Kothanur, Chikkagubbi, Thanisandra, Bagalur, Byrathi, Nagawara and nearby Bangalore areas
- Booking: WhatsApp, phone call, online contact page, or walk-in. Appointments are recommended for hair treatments, bridal makeup and nail services.
- Payments: UPI, credit/debit cards, net banking, cash. Full payment at time of service.
- Cancellation: Reschedule or cancel at least 4 hours in advance. Advance payment may be needed for makeup and hairstyling services.

## Pricing Snapshot (INR, as listed on the Services & Pricing page; subject to change)

Hair
- Haircut: Gents 300, Ladies 700, Beard styling 200, Kids headshave 500. Advanced haircuts cost extra.
- Wash & blowdry: 700 (medium), 850 (long)
- Hair spa (Gents / Ladies): Basic 800 / 1,300; Frizz Care 1,200 / 1,800; Anti Dandruff 1,200 / 1,800; Anti Hairfall 1,500 / 2,000; Bond Repair (Smartbond) 1,700 / 2,600. Long hair costs extra.
- Treatments (Gents / Ladies, onwards): Smoothening 2,000 / 5,000; Perming 2,500 / 6,000; Keratin 3,000 / 6,000; Kerashine 3,000 / 7,000; Botox/Plastia 3,500 / 10,000
- Colour (medium / long): Full global 4,500 / 6,000 (no-ammonia 5,500 / 7,000); Ombré/Balayage 7,000 / 8,500; Highlights 500 / 700 per streak; Root touch-up 1,400 (no-ammonia 1,700); Gents colour 700 (no-ammonia 900)

Skin
- Facials: Fruit 1,200; Charcoal 1,500; Wine 1,800; Diamond 1,900; Tan Elixir 2,000; Oxy Blast 2,200; Sensi Glow 2,500; Skin Whitening 3,000
- Hydra facials: Signature 3,000; Deluxe 4,000 (adds boosters and LED therapy); Platinum 5,000 (adds detox lymphatic drainage)
- Korean Glass Skin Facial: 5,000
- Cleanup: Regular 700; Acti Blend 850; O3+ 1,500
- Waxing (O3+): Underarms 150, Half arms 400, Full arms 500, Full legs 800, Full body 3,500 (bikini line not included)
- Threading: Eyebrows 50, Full face 350

Nails
- Manicure / Pedicure: from 200 / 300 (cut & file) up to 1,700 / 2,000 (Aqua Velvet)
- Gel extensions 3,000; Soft new sets 1,700; Gel polish hands 800, feet 500; Nail art 50 per nail

Makeup (at salon)
- Bridal makeup: Custom quote (includes HD makeup, bridal hairstyle, bridal saree draping, lashes)
- Groom makeup: Custom quote (includes HD makeup, hairstyle)
- Party makeup: Custom quote (includes HD makeup, party hairstyle, normal saree draping)
- Hairstyles: Party 2,000; Bridal, Advanced and Retro are custom quotes
- Saree draping: Normal 1,000; Bridal is a custom quote
- Home or venue service costs more and depends on distance. Contact the salon on WhatsApp or phone for a makeup quote.

Exact pricing depends on hair length, density and condition. Confirm with the salon.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- Where is Sugarcoat Salon? On Hennur Main Road near Capital Market Supermarket and Kanakashree Housing Society, Kannuru, Bangalore 560077.
- Is it a unisex salon? Yes. Men, women and kids are served.
- Do you offer bridal makeup? Yes: bridal, engagement, reception, party and photoshoot makeup, with trials on request. Makeup is priced by custom quote.
- Hair botox or keratin? Keratin straightens and smooths. Hair botox repairs and hydrates without straightening.
- Hair spa or hair smoothening? Hair spa is regular nourishment and scalp care. Smoothening reduces frizz and makes hair easier to manage.
- Do you serve Kothanur? Yes. The salon is on Hennur Main Road, a short drive from Kothanur.
- How do I book? WhatsApp or call +91 82965 45458, use the contact page, or walk in.
